laws.rule: Upper Mustang restricted area (Lomanthang, Lo-Ghekar Damodarkunda, Baragung Muktichetra ward 3 and Satang): special permit USD 500 per person for the first 10 days (about A$710, RBA rate of 30 October 2026), then USD 50 per person per day (about A$71.02).
laws.heading: Restricted area permit fees

laws.rule: Manaslu restricted area (Chumnubri rural municipality wards 1 to 4): September to November USD 100 per person for the first week (about A$142) then USD 15 a day (about A$21.31); December to August USD 75 for the first week (about A$107) then USD 10 a day (about A$14.20).
laws.heading: Restricted area permit fees

laws.rule: Restricted area permits are issued only to groups of two or more trekkers arranged through a registered trekking agency, are paid in Nepali rupees at the equivalent rate, and cannot run past the visa expiry date.
laws.heading: Conditions

sources.title: Trekking route and restricted area permit fees

local-law.note: Province-level record for Gandaki (Mustang, Manang, Gorkha districts). Tsum Valley and Nar-Phu (Manang) fees seen only on TAAN, an industry body, so not recorded. The Nepal Tourism Board lists Upper Mustang at USD 50 a day, which conflicts with the Department of Immigration figure used here. Immigration page read via a search-index snapshot; it refused direct fetches on 5 November 2026.
